bias.en: Breakout · gapped above every average, MACD and SAR turned up
bias.zh: 突破 · 跳空站上全部均线，MACD 与 SAR 转多

read.en: Amazon jumped 6.1% on Nov 4 to $266.03, gapping up and trading between $263.85 and $271.49 on heavy volume. It is above the falling 5-day ($249.30), 10-day ($250.17) and 30-day ($253.03) and the rising 100-day ($252.24) and 200-day ($243.67). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 4, still just below zero; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 4 ($229.36), and RSI is 60.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月4日大涨 6.1%，收于 $266.03，跳空高开，盘中区间 $263.85–271.49，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$249.30）、10 日（$250.17）和 30 日均线（$253.03）以及上行的 100 日（$252.24）和 200 日均线（$243.67）上方。MACD 于 11月4日上穿信号线，仍略低于零轴；抛物线 SAR 于 11月4日转为看多（$229.36），RSI 为 60。

read.en: The gap cleared all three written resistances ($252.3, $255, $259.5) and the $265.34 Oct 20 high, leaving an open gap from $252.45 to $263.85. Resistance is $267.6–271.5 (Aug 28 high, Nov 4 high), then $287.2 (Aug 3 high). Support is $263.9–265.3 (Nov 4 low, Oct 20 high), then $258.1–259.5 and $252.2–253.0 (100 and 30-day). A close above $271.5 would target $287; below $263.9, $258–259.5.
